def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: scp_and_upload.py <remote_path> [local_path]")
        sys.exit(1)

    remote_path = sys.argv[1]
    local_path = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else f"/tmp/{os.path.basename(remote_path)}"

    r = _resolve_account('seetacloud-westd-4x5090')
    print(f"Connecting to {r.user}@{r.hostname}:{r.port}")

    # Use sshpass + scp
    scp_cmd = [
        "sshpass", "-p", r.password,
        "scp", "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=no",
        "-o", "UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null",
        "-o", "LogLevel=ERROR",
        "-P", str(r.port),
        f"{r.user}@{r.hostname}:{remote_path}",
        local_path,
    ]
    print(f"SCP: {remote_path} -> {local_path}")
    result = subprocess.run(scp_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1800)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"SCP FAILED: {result.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)

    size_mb = os.path.getsize(local_path) / (1024 * 1024)
